description: Working memory for reusable codebase patterns and gotchas discovered during pipeline runs. Append-only comments; promote proven patterns per the 3-houses rule (technical -> docs/adr/, process -> docs/, repo guidance -> AGENTS.md via gated ticket). Working memory != gospel. Never moves past Backlog.

comments.body:
<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
From TKT-25 (codex review patterns to bake into future service slices): self-contained local gate (`make deps` before `make check`), publish Compose ports on 127.0.0.1 only, pin tool versions, never track build artifacts/node_modules. Source: PR #1 review fixes (e85bd44).

<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
From TKT-42 (CI patterns): 1) pnpm/action-setup@v6 broken in default AND standalone modes (issue #276) — use corepack on runners (version from packageManager, same as the Dockerfiles). Before bumping any pinned GH Action major, scan its open issues. 2) GHA type=gha layer cache does not persist RUN --mount=type=cache — in-Docker compiles are always cold in CI; package host-built artifacts instead (docs/testing.md §Smoke build paths).
